# Nagendra Global Innovations (NGI)

> Nagendra Global Innovations (NGI) is an Indian technology company that builds software, AI-powered tools and future-ready solutions. It is based in Andhra Pradesh, India, and was founded and is led by Mudunuru Avinash Varma, Founder and CEO. Tagline: Innovating Today. Transforming Tomorrow.

## Founder and CEO
- Mudunuru Avinash Varma (also written Avinash Varma Mudunuru, Avinash Mudunuru, Avinash Varma) is the Founder and CEO of Nagendra Global Innovations.
- Profile: https://nagendraglobalinnovations.in/mudunuru-avinash-varma.html
- Personal website: https://avinashmudunuru.in/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mudunuru-avinash-varma-810555436
- GitHub: https://github.com/AvinashMudunuru
- Born: 22 November
- Quote: "We don't build technology to predict the future; we build it to make the old way of working obsolete."
- Education: B.Tech, Computer Science and Information Technology, Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology

- Education history: Sri Gowri Vidyanikethan (school, classes 6 to 10); Sri Vivekananda Junior College (Intermediate, MPC); Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology (B.Tech CSIT, current)
- Interests: AI tools, creative interfaces, programming, building useful digital projects

- Registration: Registered on Startup India BHASKAR (ID: IN-1126-9577DW)

## Products
- FaculZo: three connected campus apps (Student, Staff, Security) for notes, leave requests, attendance, gate passes and alerts. https://faculzo.nagendraglobalinnovations.in/
- NGI Vision Connect Pro: coming soon.
